targets.rawSql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) as count FROM reports WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' GROUP BY status
SELECT AVG(EXTRACT(epoch FROM (published_at - created_at))) / 60 as minutes FROM reports WHERE status = 'ready' AND created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('hour', created_at) as time, COUNT(*) as count FROM reports WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
